form.label: OpenRouter - Provider Routing
form.description: Which upstream providers served each model, and at what cost.

search.query: `openrouter_index` sourcetype=openrouter:providers | timechart span=1h sum(total_usage_usd) by provider
`openrouter_index` sourcetype=openrouter:providers | stats sum(request_count) as requests sum(total_usage_usd) as spend_usd by model provider | sort model - spend_usd

panel.title: Cost per request by provider, same model
panel.description: A routing shift shows up here as a cost change nobody requested.

search.query: `openrouter_index` sourcetype=openrouter:providers | stats sum(total_usage_usd) as spend_usd sum(request_count) as requests by model provider | where requests>0 | eval usd_per_request=round(spend_usd/requests,6) | eventstats dc(provider) as providers by model | where providers>1 | table model provider requests usd_per_request | sort model - usd_per_request
